name: Base Field Display Configurability Override
description: Base fields may now be available in Field UI for configuration whatever the entity type has declared.
project_description: Base Field Display Configurability Override lets a site builder flip the display-configurability flag on an entity type's base fields, so normally-locked base fields (created, changed, uid, langcode, and other entity-type-declared base fields) can be surfaced in the Field UI 'Manage display' screens and assigned formatters. It provides a single admin form that writes a config map (visible / hidden / no-override per entity type and field) and a hook_entity_base_field_info_alter() implementation that applies that map by calling BaseFieldDefinition::setDisplayConfigurable('view', ...) at field-definition build time.
